bill.title: A resolution calling for the return of abducted Ukrainian children before finalizing any peace agreement to end the war against Ukraine.
bill.latestActionText: Referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations. (text: CR S3011-3012)

plain.whatItDoes: No one has written a summary of this bill yet. All we have is its title, and a title is not a description of a law. To find out what it does, you have to open the bill itself.
plain.whoItTouches: Mostly people outside the United States. It reaches most readers here only indirectly.
plain.everydayEffect: Nothing has changed yet. The title alone does not say what would change for you, and this tool will not guess. This kind of resolution does not become law, even if it passes.
plain.source: From the bill title, and from the subject labels that library staff put on it. There is no official summary of this bill yet.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
